opportunities.title: D&D Warcraft First Look: What the Stat Blocks Actually Say
opportunities.why_now: EN World just published the first hands-on look at the D&D x Warcraft crossover, and the rules details (not the art) are what determine if it's usable at your table.
opportunities.angle: Rules breakdown post that parses confirmed mechanics, monster stat blocks, and subclasses from the preview — skip the hype, cite the text.

opportunities.title: The D&D Carnival Subsystem: A Rules Audit

opportunities.title: This Week's Freebies, Decoded: Which Bundles Are Actually Rules-Complete

opportunities.title: The Two-Minute Session Zero, Fact-Checked Against the Rules
opportunities.why_now: Sly Flourish's new piece on compressed session zeros for one-shots is a procedural claim begging for a rules-first verification: does two minutes actually cover safety, tone, and character baseline per the books?
opportunities.angle: Response/analysis post that cross-references Sly Flourish's method against official session-zero guidance (DMG, safety tools) and flags what's skippable vs. load-bearing.
